page.overview:
What is Ripper?

Ripper was one of Marjorie Dursley's twelve bulldogs. He was her personal favourite and accompanied her on visits to 4 Privet Drive.

Ripper was most likely born in the mid-to-late 1980s.

Although described as "evil-tempered", Marge lavished affection on Ripper, referring to him by twee nicknames like "Rippy-pooh". She often spoiled him with food and shared her tea with him as well.

In 1990, while Marge was visiting her brother's family at 4 Privet Drive, Harry Potter accidentally stepped on one of Ripper's paws. Ripper then proceeded to chase Harry up a tree in the Dursleys' yard. Harry was stuck there until Marge called Ripper off after midnight. The incident still made Dudley Dursley laugh years later.
